description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing invoice-related operations in a React/Redux application, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting invoices.

methods.name: getInvoicesByUser
methods.description: Fetches invoices for a specific user based on a search query, dispatching loading states and the fetched data.

methods.name: getInvoice
methods.description: Fetches a specific invoice by ID and associated business profile details, then dispatches the combined data.

methods.name: createInvoice
methods.description: Creates a new invoice, updates the store, and navigates to the invoice detail page.

methods.name: updateInvoice
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice with new data and dispatches the updated invoice.

methods.name: deleteInvoice
methods.description: Deletes an invoice by ID, updates the store, and shows a success snackbar message.
